# Work Board

This board is a generated mirror of the authoritative Work Graph under `.agentflow/work/`. It is regenerated by every graph-mutating Agentflow command; hand edits here are overwritten and change nothing. To change the work itself, edit the Work Graph through Agentflow or drop a proposal — never edit this file.

## How to claim and propose work

- **Consult this board before starting.** Pick the open Work Item you intend to deliver from the list below.
- **Carry the Work-Item id in your commits.** Add a `Work-Item: <id>` trailer so the work you land is matched to its open item.
- **Propose first for uncovered work.** If what you need to do is not an open item, drop a JSON proposal into `.agentflow/proposals/`; a human ingests proposals into the graph during Framing. Proposed items below are awaiting that review and are not yet claimable.
- **Never edit `.agentflow/work/` directly.** The Work Graph is mutated only through Agentflow; direct edits are rejected.


## Open Work Items

### entitlements-two-tier

Collapse tiers to free/supporter; free groups, posting, public share, collab invites; flat hosted-media cap (100MB/5GB); anti-abuse rate limits (GH #147)

Depends on: nothing

Acceptance criteria:
- Tier type is free|supporter only; legacy PRO/STUDIO/PREMIUM_* values normalize to supporter
- group_create, social_post, public_share, collab_invites are enabled for the free tier in the entitlements matrix
- Storage caps collapse to one rule: free 100MB, supporter 5120MB, in both entitlements.ts and cloudStoragePolicy.ts; the group-cosplay exception (FREE_GROUP_BUILD_LIMIT, FREE_GROUP_CLOUD_MB, group branch of canUploadBuildToCloud) is removed and its spec tests are amended together with their source requirements
- Publish and group-create mutations enforce per-user daily anti-abuse limits (20 posts/day, 5 group creates/day, all tiers) via @convex-dev/rate-limiter, in the same mutations that call requireFeature
- docs/PRODUCT_SPEC.md REQ-017/018/019/021/D90 and docs/DATA_AND_SYNC.md section 9 are amended to match; upgrade paywall prompts for group create and posting are removed from web and mobile

### r2-media-pipeline

Hosted media moves to Cloudflare R2: presigned uploads, capability-URL serving, client-side derivatives, size verification, cap metering (GH #148, ADR 0001)

Depends on: entitlements-two-tier

Acceptance criteria:
- @convex-dev/r2 is configured; uploads flow through presigned R2 URLs; rows store a mediaKey object key containing a random UUID; a single shared helper derives public media-domain URLs from keys
- Attach mutations verify the uploaded object's actual size (reject and delete objects over the hard ceiling ~2MB) and meter bytes against currentUsageMb via the existing checkLimitAndAddUsage machinery pointed at R2 object metadata
- Web and mobile publish paths compress client-side to a single derivative: longest edge <=1600px, WebP ~q80, EXIF stripped; no server-side image processing and no thumbnail variants exist
- No signed URLs are minted anywhere for hosted media (ADR 0001)

### media-storage-migration

One-shot migration of existing Convex _storage media to R2; imageStorageId fields and dual-read removed (GH #148)

Depends on: r2-media-pipeline

Acceptance criteria:
- A @convex-dev/migrations job copies every existing _storage blob to R2, stamps mediaKey on its row, and deletes the _storage blob
- imageStorageId is removed from the schema (~8 tables) and from all readers; any temporary dual-read fallback is deleted in this same work item
- No code path writes new files to Convex _storage; storage size lookups read R2 metadata only

### media-takedown-admin

Admin takedown path and link-accessibility copy for hosted media (GH #148, ADR 0001)

Depends on: r2-media-pipeline

Acceptance criteria:
- An admin mutation removes a hosted media item completely: deletes the row, deletes the R2 object, and purges the CDN cache
- Upload/publish UI copy states that published and shared photos are link-accessible

### sync-merge-engine

Pure BYO-sync merge engine in design-system/domain: versioned snapshot, per-record LWW, tombstones, content-hash media manifest (GH #149, ADR 0003)

Depends on: nothing

Acceptance criteria:
- Snapshot format (kyarafit.json) covers all personal tables, carries schemaVersion, and every record carries updatedAt; the format evolves the existing export bundle
- Merge is per-record last-writer-wins; deletes are tombstones (deletedAt, ~90-day retention) and a deleted record is never resurrected by merging an older snapshot
- Vitest property tests demonstrate merge commutativity and idempotence
- The engine is pure functions in @kyarafit/design-system/domain behind a transport interface, with no platform or network imports; media are referenced by content hash in a manifest of immutable files

### drive-transport-oauth

Google Drive transport adapter (drive.file) with incremental-consent OAuth reusing the Better Auth Google client (GH #149)

Depends on: sync-merge-engine

Acceptance criteria:
- A Drive adapter implements the engine's transport interface: Kyarafit folder bootstrap, snapshot get/put, media put-if-absent by content hash, tolerant of concurrent uploads from other devices
- Only the non-sensitive drive.file scope is requested, via incremental consent at sync-enable time, reusing the existing Better Auth Google client on web and Expo
- Access/refresh tokens are stored and refreshed; an expired or revoked grant surfaces as a reconnect state rather than an error loop

### sync-settings-web

Web sync-method selector, triggers, and Settings > Data UI: Off / Google Drive / Kyarafit Cloud with cloud_sync gating (GH #149)

Depends on: drive-transport-oauth, entitlements-two-tier

Acceptance criteria:
- Sync method is a mutually exclusive setting (Off / Google Drive / Kyarafit Cloud); Kyarafit Cloud is visible to all but selectable only with the cloud_sync entitlement, enforced server-side in the single mutation that changes the method; switching methods performs one final merge-and-push through the old method before the new one becomes authoritative
- Sync runs on app start/foreground and debounced ~30s after the last local mutation, wired through the existing offline layer; no background sync; sync failure never blocks local reads or writes
- Settings > Data shows connect/disconnect, last-synced time, a Sync now button, and a reconnect state; no floating status chrome anywhere (ADR 0002-status-surfaces-live-in-settings)
- Connect-time copy states data syncs through the user's own Google Drive and Kyarafit servers never store it
- Manual export/import uses merge-on-import through the engine's file adapter; docs/DATA_AND_SYNC.md is amended with the sync-method model

### sync-settings-mobile

Mobile (Expo) BYO sync surface: OAuth flow and Settings > Data screens calling the shared engine, clear of glass-studio chrome (GH #149)

Depends on: sync-settings-web

Acceptance criteria:
- Mobile Settings > Data offers the same sync-method selector, status, Sync now, and reconnect states as web, calling the shared engine and Drive adapter
- The Drive incremental-consent flow completes on Expo (iOS and Android)
- No changes to tab bar, headers, sheets, or other chrome surfaces owned by the glass-studio work; the slice rebases on whatever glass-studio has merged
